text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, Ticket-san, sorry to keep you 
waiting! What should we have for lunch to—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
The morning went super well, let's keep 
giving it our all and kepparu this 
afternoon too!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Kepparu, kepparu~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Kepparu? Huh? Are there a bunch of girls 
from Hokkaido here??

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No, those are... fans of yours, Spe-san.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, you've been doing so amazing 
lately, right? More and more girls are 
copying you because they wanna be just 
like you!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? I-If that's true... I'm really happy, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Extra large rice refill, please! The same 
mountain of food Spe-san eats!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Everyone has the same hairstyle as 
Spe-san...! You're super popular here 
too...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It really is true...! Everyone's genuinely 
looking up to me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(To live up to everyone's expectations, 
with training and conditioning—I have to 
give it my all and kepparu even 
harder...!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uoooooooooh!! Not done yet! One more lap!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Seconds! Another bowl!! And one more after 
that, please!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan's been on fire lately! Running a 
ton, eating a ton!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yes... But Rice is a little worried...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...! That's weird... I've 
been training so much, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My body feels... so heavy...

text_block_list.name: Rice & Ticket
text_block_list.text: Spe-san...! Spe-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaa... You suddenly wobbled and 
collapsed, we were so worried, waaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice was really startled too... Now that 
you've changed, let's head back to the 
dorms for—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Spe-san...?! What's with all that 
food?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I can't run, eating is all I have 
left... I've gained weight lately, but if 
I can turn it into muscle, surely...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Spe-san...! You'll collapse from 
overeating...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly~!! Hayahide always says 
balanced nutrition and moderate exercise 
make the ideal... uh, anyway, make an 
awesome body!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No buts, no Derbys!! If you push yourself 
too hard and collapse again, what are 
we... what are we gonna dooooo?!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-san... ...I'm sorry. I was just so 
happy that everyone recognized me and 
looked up to me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to meet their expectations and 
kepparu harder than ever before... but 
instead I ended up like this...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-That's not true at all...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san, you're always so earnest and full 
of energy even when you fail... Just 
watching you gives everyone around you so 
much strength...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Plus, you charge straight 
toward your dreams!! Seeing you makes me 
feel like I gotta give it everything I've 
got too!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So... you don't have to push yourself or 
overthink it... Th-The Spe-san right now 
is already wonderful enough!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's right, that's right!!! The Spe-chan 
you are right now is amazing!! We love you 
just the way you are, waaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuu... Rice-san, Ticket-san... desu_ne...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're right... The person everyone was 
looking up to was just regular old me, 
wasn't it...! I'll keep giving it my all 
as myself from now on!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Though to do that... I guess first I have 
to work off all that extra food I ate, 
desu_ne...!!
